findings.title: Saturação de risco incompatível com controle herdado
findings.evidence: The exact delivery preflight rejected the published result-only child because active inherited control CTRL-1039-VISUAL-OPEN-MOBILE-001 uses risk family semantic-effect while risk-saturation omitted that family.
